name: smwmusic-silent-service-unused-theme
title: Silent Service - Unused Theme 5
description:
The fifth Unused theme from a fairly obscure NES game, Silent Service, whose soundtrack was composed by none other than David Wise, the composer of Donkey Kong Country.

Shame that the only used song was the title screen one, with the rest of the songs ending up unused, like this one.

Could fit overworlds or upbeat retro levels.
